candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces show the gateway's checkout call failing because the downstream order call returned 500, so the checkout 502s are a propagated downstream server error originating in the order service.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order (db, payment, inventory) is not established; order-side logs/traces were not admitted.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s correlate with order service 500s on POST /v1/orders in the same traces; topology confirms gateway->order dependency. The bounded cause is a downstream order-service server error propagating to checkout. The specific fault inside order is not yet established.
